concept:
Use case: sketch-to-render / game UI concept.
Generate a finished Bullets of Fury HUD concept from the attached user sketch, faithfully following its layout. This is a flat orthographic 2D sprite HUD, not a physical console or 3D render.
Input 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE LAYOUT sketch. Input 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE from this game's existing HUD atlas: authored Neo-Geo / Sega 32X pixel art, dark gunmetal bevels, fine steel edges, restrained amber lights and compact arcade lettering. Input 3 is the STYLE REFERENCE for the boss health bar only. Do not reproduce the atlas or invent extra modules.
OUTPUT: a single extra-wide horizontal HUD on actual transparent background, roughly 1536 by 256 pixels. The whole HUD is visible with a tiny transparent safety margin; no contact sheet, no multiple alternatives. Do not include the sketch's large empty white playfield. The HUD has one connected upper metal assembly, three lower beveled tabs, and one thin boss status lane underneath. No perspective, no shadows outside the art, no surrounding presentation board.

EXACT LAYOUT, expressed on the sketch's 1006-unit width:
- Main connected strip spans x=0..1006, y=0..72.
- LEFT x=0..241: two horizontal green segmented meter tracks stacked. Small legible labels directly above each: "ROLL", "SOMERSAULT". Meter interiors dark; upper meter 100% full, lower 70% full. A beveled lower tab slopes inward from this panel at y=72 to y=94 and reads "LIVES × 3". Thin steel trim, no portrait.
- WEAPON x=248..341: a compact square recess, its top label "WEAPON", small golden pixel-art chaingun weapon icon in the center, tiny "III" level marker below. This must remain distinctly a square module.
- CENTER x=359..616: label "CHAIN LIGHTNING" above one long red segmented special-ability meter, about 70% full. A small square keycap "X" sits just before the ability name within this same heading. The wide beveled lower tab below x=359..626 slopes inward at y=72..98 and contains two clearly separated small rows horizontally beside each other: "SPEED" with five amber square upgrade pips (3 lit), "SHIELD" with five cyan square upgrade pips (4 lit). The lower center tab stays shallow.
- RADAR x=647..740: separate compact square framed radar display, label "RADAR" on its upper bezel. Very dark green screen, subtle lime sweep arc and 3 tiny blips. Keep this square, do not extend it to fill the right third.
- RIGHT x=751..1006: a horizontally rounded/chamfered lock-on capsule at x=792..944, y=18..49, with a tiny amber target reticle and the exact label "LOCK-ON". Its own beveled lower tab x=751..966, y=72..94 reads "MISSILES × 6".
- Maintain the spatial order LEFT MANEUVERS / WEAPON / CENTER SPECIAL / RADAR / RIGHT LOCK-ON. All are joined by the same continuous steel fascia.
- BOSS LANE: directly beneath all three tabs, from y=100..136 across the width, make a slim separate boss status frame. Small readable name "STORM SOVEREIGN" above a long orange segmented HP fill 75% full with dark remainder. A very thin cyan secondary shield track under that fill within the SAME boss lane. Use restrained yellow-black hazard end caps from reference 3. The name is inside the boss lane, never overlaps the player HUD. The boss lane is visually subordinate, horizontally wide and shallow.
- The area below and the gaps around the beveled tabs must be actual alpha transparency.

Art direction: disciplined, crisp dense pixel clusters; cool dark graphite and steel framing; black recessed slots; 1-2 pixel highlights; restrained copper/amber corner rivets. Clean, functional arcade readability, compact chamfered shapes. Green, red, cyan and amber stay distinct. The metal frame should be thin enough that the meters and labels dominate. Flat front view. No bloom, no blurred text, no film grain, no giant warning triangles, no decorative skulls/wings, no duplicated labels, no score/high score/time/portrait boxes, no bottom or side HUD, no invented logos. Render all listed text accurately. This is a faithful polish of the supplied sketch, not a layout redesign.
blank_frame:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied finished Bullets of Fury HUD into its EMPTY PRODUCTION FRAME counterpart. This image is the sole edit target. Preserve the exact connected panel layout, pixel-metal art style, thin bevels, corner bolts, weapon square, radar square, lock-on capsule, three lower tabs, boss health bar housing and hazard-striped ends. Keep every panel in the same relative position and at the same relative scale.
Remove ALL lettering, digits, keycap markings, weapon icons, crosshair icons, radar grid/sweep/blips, lit upgrade pips and colored meter fills. Leave the dark opaque recessed interiors and empty meter/pip outlines. All label areas become clean blank dark gunmetal or black recesses matching their surroundings. No invented markings. The red special track becomes an empty dark track. The two green maneuver tracks become empty dark tracks. The boss orange HP track and thin cyan shield track become empty dark tracks, with their empty segment outlines retained. Boss name plate stays present but blank. The right lock-on capsule stays but is empty.
Preserve amber frame hardware lights, graphite/steel colors and yellow-black hazard end caps: those belong to the frame, not live data. Preserve the shape of all three lower beveled tabs. Make the outside and all gaps TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENT. Remove stray isolated colored noise pixels outside the frame. TIGHTLY FRAME THE ART with only 8 transparent pixels of padding beyond its extreme top, bottom, left and right edges; no large unused transparent border. Single wide horizontal frame set. Crisp flat authored pixel art; no blur, no bloom, no perspective. Do not rearrange, stretch, duplicate, add or delete any HUD panel.
